name: Ice Shot Deadeye
summary: Cold bow build with the same league-start shell as Lightning Arrow. Ice Shot converts physical damage to cold, freezes the first pack, and turns a rare bow into the main damage slot. No required unique.

pros.text: Fast clear with freeze and shatter; a single arrow covers a pack.
No required unique; the rare bow is the whole damage slot.
Freeze is a real defensive layer while you learn map layouts.
Critical strikes and added cold scale cleanly into red maps.
Ranged play keeps you out of most retaliation range.
Gear upgrades are easy to compare because one weapon carries the damage.

cons.text: Evasion is the defensive layer; a bad streak of hits ends the map.
Single-target needs investment beyond the clear setup.
Critical gear is expensive relative to a plain resistance set.
Cold penetration is a separate upgrade from raw damage.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are online.
No built-in sustain; leech or life flasks have to cover it.

summary.text: Ice Shot Deadeye is a cold bow build that measures 200.7k at red maps and 394.1k at pinnacle. Freeze is the defensive layer, the rare bow is the damage slot, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Ice Shot and added cold, then add the critical supports as they unlock. The first checkpoint measures 383 life and 81 damage; the second measures 735. Keep a mana flask until leech and reduced cost are online.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 200.7k damage, 27759 effective life and 7995 physical max hit. Freeze the first pack, keep the bow current, and cap the elemental resistances.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 394.1k damage with 36559 effective life and 9668 physical max hit. Keep the mark up and fire from outside the boss's slam range; the freeze is a bonus, not a plan.
